description: This class serves as a builder for constructing instances of CommandProcessingResult, encapsulating the outcome details of processing a command in the Fineract system. It provides chainable methods to set various result attributes like IDs, resource identifiers, changes, external IDs, and transaction details.

classes.name: CommandProcessingResultBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating CommandProcessingResult objects with detailed result data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a CommandProcessingResult instance with the current builder state.

methods.name: withResourceIdAsString
methods.description: Sets the resource identifier as a string.

methods.name: withCreditReport
methods.description: Sets the credit bureau report data.

methods.name: setRollbackTransaction
methods.description: Sets whether to rollback the transaction.
